Timelines for decommissioning of OCP-C1:
 * Jun 12, 2024 - disable the access to the API/UI of the cluster
 * Jun 26, 2024 - shutdown the nodes of the cluster
 * Jul 29, 2024 - decommission the cluster - data that wasn't migrated, will be deleted

See the migration guide:
 - See
[https://source.redhat.com/departments/it/devit/it-infrastructure/itcloudservices/itocp/it_paas_blog/action_required_psi_ocp_c1_decommissioning_notice]

Work done during migration:
 # Before the base image was "centos:stream9", I changed it to "registry.redhat.io/rhel8/rsyslog"
 # DeploymentConfig is deprecated, so use Deployment instead. So code reference it needs to be updated. MRs are added in the comments.
 # All images are pushed to [https://images.paas.redhat.com/organization/rat] instead of using imagesteam, sometimes imagesteam often fails. I append "stage" to the repo for the "stage" env.
 ## We need to create a robot at [https://images.paas.redhat.com/organization/rat?tab=robots]  and then create a secret based on the docker configuration if the default secret "images-paas-push-config" in the project doesn't work
 # BuildConfig will be deprecated slowly too, but to save the migration work, I still use it. Later we can change to openshift Pipeline.

Important Steps:
 # By default, the pod can not reach the external network, we need to update TenantEngress to allow the required website, but even if "github.com" is added, it still can not reach, so I add http_proxy, https_proxy, no_proxy for it. But the connections between services are disturbed, we need to update no_proxy if any network error happens.
 # oc adm policy add-role-to-user admin system:serviceaccount:insights-rule-dev-rat–prod:default
 # oc adm policy add-role-to-user admin system:serviceaccount:insights-rule-dev-rat–stage:default
 # When creating route, follow [https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/4.15/networking/routes/route-configuration.html#nw-ingress-sharding-route-configuration_route-configuration] and the [https://source.redhat.com/departments/it/devit/it-infrastructure/itcloudservices/itocp/managedplatformplushub/mppluswiki/user_tenant_onboarding_and_administration#ingress-shards]
 # variable "RAT_API_BASE_URL" used in nodejs in rat-ui must be set when building image

Since the DataHub outage happens occasionally, and for most Advisor rules it's not so strict about data dates, we'd better implement the following feature in RAT:
 - to automatically run rules using the last day on which the complete data are available

To let the users know when the archives are from, there is a new line added to "{*}Rule Runtime Information{*}" like bellow.
|Date of archives|2023-09-19(This is the last day with complete data, do not be confused if there is a big gap)|

With the date info, the users can know when the archive were generated and if they contain the new specs or not.

The current Database schema is:
{code:java}
	`id` int4 NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
	`userid` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
	`queued_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
	`queued_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
	`run_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
	`run_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
	`state` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
	`failure_details` varchar(5120) NULL,
	`rule_code_path` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`core_code_path` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`rules` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL,
	`results_path` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`results_csv_path` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`results_parquet_path` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`role` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`active` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
	`data` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL,
	`num_archives` int4 DEFAULT NULL,
	`description` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
	`runtime_args` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL,
{code}
To support the Smart Archive Selection in all required RAT components, make sure the required information would be consistent between the rat-cli, rat-API, rat-ui, we'd better update the schema.

 

 

The proposed new columns to the schema:
{code:java}
`all_archives` int4 DEFAULT NULL, # - The number of all archives in the DataHub
`tgt_archives` int4 DEFAULT NULL, # - The number of archives that match the Job requirements (rules + includes - excludes)
`num_archives` int4 DEFAULT NULL, # - The number of archives specified by "--num_archives" [This is an existing one]
`run_archives` int4 DEFAULT NULL, # - The number of archives that are actually run for the rule in this Job
`rule_specs` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,  # - The list of dependency specs of the rule
`include_specs` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,  # - The list of specs specified by "--include-specs"
`exclude_specs` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,  # - The list of specs  specified by "--exclude-specs" {code}

* The {{num_archives}} is the existing column but not a new one to add, just list it here together for reference. 
   Thank you [~accountid:70121:d503755d-fe22-41ef-a3a1-960c059201c4] for the reminder in the Sync meeting, I didn't aware of this before you pointed it out.

https://rat.apps.ocp-c1.prod.psi.redhat.com/raui/jobs/137/reports/report

Root cause:

Due to this condition: https://gitlab.cee.redhat.com/cee-data-engineering/rat-2-aggregate/-/blob/develop/rat_aggregate/aggregate.py#L302, it is possible that the "failed" responses are not collected into the rule-results.json if the ranking of "failed" responses is low.

Resolution:
Current keys of rule-results.json are ['runtime_info', 'rule_stats', 'rule_responses', 'exceptions'], we decided to add a new key "failed_rule_responses" to show the data of "failed" responses.

items.toString:
h3. rat-api
The archive download process frequently failed, when fetching the 'metadata/archive_info.parquet' from datahub.
{code}
[2022-02-15 02:28:21 +0000] [2525] [DEBUG] GET /v1.0/archives/48946347-4d97-424a-9a91-b2a70be812e9
INFO:archives.s3:ObjectStorage:Retrieving 'metadata/archive_info.parquet'
[2022-02-15 02:28:24 +0000] [3317] [INFO] Booting worker with pid: 3317  <--<< gunicron restarted here
{code}

h3. rat-driver

{quote}
It's the rat-driver who met this OOMKilled and cannot startup. I did a bit of debugging and also found it might be caused by the "read_parquet" function when reading the large parquet file: here.
And I also found this issue in the archive-downloading service, sometimes, we need to refresh the webpage times to get the archive being downloaded (I opened a Jira for this, see RAT-147)

After modifying the "read_parquet" as follows and testing in the RAT-DEV env, the OOM issue seems to be resolved.
---
archive_info = pd.read_parquet(f, columns=['account', 'inventory_id', 'file_name', 'request_id']).to_dict('records')
---

However, what confused me is, if this is the root cause of the OOMKilled issue, It should not only impact the Jobs with a large "num_archives", Since no matter how many the "num_archives" is being specified, the rat-driver needs to download and read the SAME parquet file, right? All jobs should be failed due to this issue, but it only occurs when a large "num_archives" is specified.

Does it mean the reading of the large ".parquet" file won't cause OOM, but the "archive_info" will also need to allocate a huge buffer to store the "num_archives" of archive_meta, when it reaches the limitation, OOM occurred.

And, I don't think the "columns" limitation to the "read_parquet" is the best resolution for this issue.  We need to do more updates to reduce memory consumption since the number of collected archives will be more and more.

[related]  RAT-147 it may be the same with your ETL App
The ‘gunicron’ restarted automatically when doing the “io.BytesIO(obj)” or “read_parquet” (even “columns” is used in this read_parquet)
{quote}
[Bob] Do not convert the parquet to dict, using padas.DataFrame directly might work 
[Lloyd] Do not store the “archive_info” in multiple places while getting the archives’ information.
